-- clean --
CC := gcc
CFLAGS += -O2
SRCS := $(wildcard *.c)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
export TOKEN := secret

.PHONY: all clean

all: app

app: $(OBJS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^ && echo "$$TOKEN"

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

clean:
	rm -f app $(OBJS)
-- missing-separator --
all
	echo all
-- missing-separator-later --
all:
	@echo all
garbage words here
-- recipe-before-rule --
	echo hi
all:
	@echo all
-- recipe-after-assignment --
all:
	@echo all
FOO = bar
	echo not a recipe
-- spaces-instead-of-tab --
all:
    echo all
-- spaces-assignment-after-rule --
all:
	@echo $(X)
    X = 1
-- recipe-prefix-changed --
.RECIPEPREFIX = >
all:
> @echo one
	@echo two
-- missing-endif --
ifdef DEBUG
X = 1
all:
	@echo $(X)
-- extraneous-else --
else
all:
	@echo all
-- extraneous-endif --
endif
all:
	@echo all
-- bad-conditional --
ifeq (a
endif
all:
	@echo all
-- conditionals-balanced --
ifeq ($(MODE),debug)
X = -g
else ifeq ($(MODE),release)
X = -O2
else
X =
endif
ifneq "$(X)" ""
Y := yes
endif
all:
	@echo $(X) $(Y)
-- missing-endef --
define HELP
usage
all:
	@echo all
-- extraneous-endef --
endef
all:
	@echo all
-- define-used --
define GREETING =
@echo hello
endef
all:
	$(GREETING)
-- unterminated-reference --
all:
	@echo $(CFLAGS
-- insufficient-arguments --
X := $(subst a,b)
all:
	@echo $(X)
-- extra-commas-are-fine --
X := $(if a,b,c,d)
all:
	@echo $(X)
-- unknown-function --
X := $(wild *.c)
all:
	@echo x$(X)x
-- recursive-variable --
X = $(X) a
all:
	@echo $(X)
-- recursive-chain --
A = $(B)
B = $(A)
all:
	@echo $(A)
-- simple-self-reference --
X := a
X := $(X) b
all:
	@echo $(X)
-- append --
X = a
X += b
all:
	@echo $(X)
-- duplicate-recipe --
all:
	@echo one
all:
	@echo two
-- double-colon-rules --
all::
	@echo one
all::
	@echo two
-- phony-without-rule --
.PHONY: all clena
all:
	@echo all
-- missing-include --
include nothere.mk
all:
	@echo all
-- optional-include --
-include nothere.mk
sinclude other.mk
all:
	@echo all
-- undefined-variable --
all:
	@echo $(NOPE)
-- builtin-variables --
all:
	@echo $(CC) $(MAKE) $(CURDIR) $(RM) $(SHELL)
-- automatic-variables --
all: dep
	@echo $@ $< $^ $(@D) $(<F)
dep:
	@echo $@
-- unused-variable --
UNUSED := 1
all:
	@echo all
-- exported-variable-unused-in-make --
export TOKEN := 1
all:
	@echo $$TOKEN
-- flags-variable --
CFLAGS := -O2
all:
	@echo all
-- target-specific --
all: MODE = fast
all:
	@echo $(MODE)
-- inline-recipe --
all: ; @echo inline
-- static-pattern --
objs := a.o b.o
all: $(objs)
$(objs): %.o: %.c
	@echo $<
%.c:
	@touch $@
-- order-only --
all: | dir
	@echo all
dir:
	@mkdir -p dir
-- foreach-binding --
NAMES := a b
all:
	@echo $(foreach n,$(NAMES),$(n).o)
-- call-function --
greet = hello $(1)
all:
	@echo $(call greet,world)
-- computed-name --
a_flags := 1
kind := a
all:
	@echo $($(kind)_flags)
-- override-and-export --
override X := 1
export Y = 2
unexport Z
all:
	@echo $(X) $$Y
-- vpath --
vpath %.c src
all:
	@echo all
-- oneshell --
.ONESHELL:
all:
	@cd /tmp
	@pwd
-- recursive-make --
all:
	$(MAKE) build
build:
	@echo build
-- expression-line --
$(info hello)
all:
	@echo all
-- empty-reference-line --
$(nothing)
all:
	@echo all
-- conditional-in-recipe --
all:
ifdef X
	@echo x
else
	@echo y
endif
-- shell-assignment --
NOW != date
all:
	@echo $(NOW)
-- question-assignment --
X ?= 1
all:
	@echo $(X)
-- continuation --
SRCS = a.c \
       b.c
all:
	@echo $(SRCS)
-- comment-handling --
X = 1 # trailing comment
# full comment
all: # comment after rule
	@echo $(X) # shell comment
-- export-names-only --
FOO := 1
export FOO
unexport BAR
all:
	@echo $$FOO
-- semicolon-before-colon --
a;b:
	@echo $@
-- reference-ends-at-the-first-parenthesis --
x := $(()
all:
	@echo [$(x(y)z)]
-- function-arguments-balance-parentheses --
all:
	@echo $(subst (,X,a(b)c)
-- grouped-targets-need-a-recipe --
a b &: c
all:
-- recipe-before-the-first-rule --
	$(info hi)
all:
-- tab-prefixed-assignment-before-a-rule --
	x = 1
all:
	@echo $(x)
-- rule-without-targets --
: b
	echo $(
all:
-- whitespace-in-a-variable-name --
a b = c
all:
-- assignment-without-a-name --
= c
all:
-- text-after-a-reference --
$(x)y
all:
-- unused-self-reference --
A = $(A) more
all:
-- deferred-unterminated-reference --
A = $(B
all:
-- self-reference-expanded-only-through-an-unused-variable --
A = $(A)
B = $(A)
all:
-- self-reference-expanded-by-a-recipe --
A = $(A) more
all:
	@echo $(A)
-- static-pattern-without-percent --
a.o: obj: a.c
	cc a.c
-- dollar-space-is-a-variable --
$ 
all:
-- directive-word-as-a-variable --
define = 1
export := 2
all:
	@echo $(define) $(export)
-- directive-word-as-a-target --
export:
	@echo exported
-- directive-before-a-spaced-colon --
vpath :
	@echo r
all:
